text:
Predicates:
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Season(s) ::: s is a season.
Emma ::: Emma.
Mia ::: Mia.
James ::: James.
Spring ::: the spring season.
Summer ::: the summer season.
Fall ::: the fall season.
Winter ::: the winter season.
Premises:
∀s (Season(s)) ::: There are four seasons in a year: Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
∀x (WantLongVacation(x) → FavoriteSeason(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(Emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
¬FavoriteSeason(Mia, Emma) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
WantLongVacation(James) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(Mia, spring) ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
